parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: DomainType
parameters.description:
The type of the domain name that you want to query. Valid values:

*   **root**: root domain name
*   **sub**: subdomain name

parameters.name: FuzzyDomain
parameters.description: The keyword that is used to query domain names. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-domain-list --source-ip 192.122.XX.XX --fuzzy-domain sas --domain-type root --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeDomainList --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '192.122.XX.XX' --DomainType root --PageSize 10 --CurrentPage 1 --FuzzyDomain sas
